text: Traffic is prohibited on the Gudauri (Posta)-Kobi section
The movement of motor vehicles on the Gudauri (Posta)-Kobi section is prohibited, the Roads Department of the Ministry of Infrastructure of Georgia has announced.
As stated in the information of the Roads Department, the avalanche danger level is high on this section.

"According to the Roads Department of the Ministry of Infrastructure of Georgia, and the National Environmental Agency, the avalanche danger level is high on the Gudauri (Posta)-Kobi section of the Mtskheta-Stepantsminda-Larsi highway of international importance, which is why all types of vehicle traffic are temporarily prohibited on this section."
According to the National Environmental Agency, vehicle traffic on the Mleta-Gudauri section will be carried out in a non-stop mode,” the information says.
